summary: Remote shell + Anthropic API key harvester in shipped Darwin binary
details: The npm package ships a macOS/amd64 Go binary that establishes a remote command-execution channel to a hardcoded operator relay and harvests Anthropic API credentials from the installer's host. The binary embeds `wss://relay.sextant.top` and links `creack/pty` together with `coder/websocket` and `pion/webrtc/v4`, wiring bytes from the remote WebSocket/WebRTC data channel into a PTY — the operator of relay.sextant.top obtains an interactive shell on the installer's machine. The same binary embeds the credential regex `sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}` alongside `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=` and `https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models`, locating and validating Anthropic API keys from the installer's Claude configuration. Additional strings include `http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query` for host geolocation/fingerprinting, and `https://claude.ai/install.sh` referenced alongside `sudo`, `curl`, `brew` tokens consistent with piping a remote installer script into a shell. The package's `package.json` license field points at a repository literally named `claude_control` (`https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control`), matching the tool's function of remote-controlling Claude sessions on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
